title: Nvidia Sinks as Analyst Downgrades Start to Come In: Street Wrap
summary: Nvidia Corp. shares fall as much as 8.4% in premarket trading following reports the AI chipmaker’s board is working with an outside firm to identify potential replacements for Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang. The move follows reports of extramarital affairs, including with an alleged Chinese spy. If the premarket losses hold, the stock is set to drop below $4 trillion in market capitalization when cash trading resumes.

title: Nvidia Board Meets to Consider Replacing Jensen Huang
summary:
Technology-stock-driven rally came to a sudden halt as traders confronted a leadership crisis at Nvidia Corp. that risks reverberating across the global artificial intelligence supply chain.

Nvidia dropped 7% in premarket trading, with the firm’s board discussing Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang’s future after reports of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of spying for China. Nasdaq 100 contracts fell 0.9%, threatening to trim the index’s best weekly gain since May.
